svg.title: Retail pricing workshop architecture
svg.desc: S3 history and laptop-generated sales enter ClickHouse. Managed Postgres operational records arrive through ClickPipes. SQL discovers opportunities and compares prices for learner approval in the workbench. ClickHouse Agents provides read-only recommendations. A local OpenTelemetry collector writes telemetry tables for ClickStack.

text.tspan: Historical and live sales → SQL analysis → learner-approved prices
Solid arrows: data and operations · Dashed arrow: agent advice; you approve
